review.intent_summary: Provide inspectable short-history observations, changes, and departure candidates with explicit comparison limits and no unsupported action eligibility.

criteria.criterion: The first observation records a value, the second records a change, and later departures from the prior range can be candidates.
Descriptive assessments use preceding observations and remain unchanged when future samples are appended.
Missing values break the comparison history, and zero previous values do not create relative-change evidence.
Early candidates remain non-triggering and ineligible for action even under a permissive policy.

verification_evidence: Runtime manual check using .venv/Scripts/python.exe: analyzed [10,12,11,20] and replayed permissive policy; candidate compared against three preceding observations with range [10,12] and median 11.
Inspected candidate output: maturity early, explicit established/not_established claims, criterion_met=false, action_eligible=false, notification_eligible=false, and zero cases.
